desc: Implement `flipsNeeded(L)`: if L == 1, return min mismatches against both alternating targets ("0101...", "1010..."); else parse s into maximal runs and sum run_len // (L+1).
Implement binary search in `minLength` over lo=1, hi=n using `flipsNeeded(L) <= numOps` as predicate; return minimal feasible L.
Verify against examples: "000001"/1 -> 2, "0000"/2 -> 1, "0101"/0 -> 1; plus edge cases n=1, numOps=0 with all-same string, numOps=n, s="010"/numOps=1 -> 1.
(Optional) Cross-check with an O(n^2) brute-force/DP validator for small n to confirm the greedy run-splitting formula.
